name: Aid
description: Level 2 Abjuration (Bard, Doctor, Druid, Warden, Navigator) Casting Time: Action Range: 30 feet Components: V, S, M (a strip of white cloth) Duration: 8 hours Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target's Health maximum and current Health increase by 5 for the duration. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. Each target's Health increase by 5 for each spell slot level above 2.
